AI & Marketing Concepts

Archivetainment

A content consumption trend where old shows, concerts, or ads are rediscovered and mass-consumed as entertainment on today's digital platforms.

Explanation

Archivetainment blends "archive" and "entertainment" to describe how nostalgic content is repackaged for modern audiences, including younger viewers who did not experience it the first time. For marketers, it opens opportunities in repurposing old campaigns as branded nostalgia, monetizing archived content on streaming or social platforms, and strengthening cultural relevance by tapping into shared collective memory.

Usage context / examples

The Turkish section cites Turkish examples such as reruns of the old program "32. Gün" and live rewatches of the 2000s series "Avrupa Yakası" drawing millions of views; the English section instead cites "Friends," "The Office," Michael Jordan's NBA finals, the 2006 FIFA World Cup, and Queen's 1985 Live Aid performance.

Turkish equivalent

Archivetainment (Arşiv Eğlencesi)

Turkish definition

Geçmişe ait program, dizi, konser veya reklamların günümüz dijital platformlarında yeniden izlenerek kitlesel eğlenceye dönüşmesidir.
